$description: Source of truth for the Salla Design System component inventory. Each entry classifies one public component on three axes (atomic level, Material category, structure type) and links it back to the Figma frames it comes from (see figma-inventory.json) and the Twilight Storybook story. scripts/build-catalog.py renders docs/03-components from this file.

structureTypes.3: Base + Global (internal base component, public pre-configured components)

components.name: Button
components.summary: The single action trigger. Seven colour variants x four appearances x three sizes x five states, plus a circular layout for icon-only use.
components.rtl: iconStart/iconEnd are logical (inline-start / inline-end) and swap automatically under dir=rtl; do not mirror non-directional glyphs.
components.notes: Figma variant values carry a leading `--` (--primary); drop it in code. The 'link' appearance is a Button in Figma but reads as a Link to users; expose it as `Link` (see link.md) built on the same base. `feature` is a non-semantic upsell accent and must stay out of the semantic status palette.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Icon-only button. Today this is Button with Layout=--circular and no label; promote it to a named global component so the accessible name is a required prop.
components.notes: Replaces the ad-hoc icon buttons inside Table (_Table/Refresh Button, _Table/Pin, Table/Cell/Actions icons).

components.name: Link
components.summary: Inline text action. Built on BaseButton with the `link` and `link-auxiliary` appearances so it shares focus, disabled and loading logic with Button.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: A single glyph from the Salla icon set. 4,049 names in Stroke (outline) and Solid (filled) styles; Rounded is the default type.
components.rtl: Only directional glyphs (arrows, chevrons, undo/redo) set mirrorInRtl. Search, trash, settings never mirror.
components.notes: Naming today is `{name}-{outline|filled}` in the Merchant DS while the icon library uses Style/Type variants and the Storybook uses `sicon-*` font classes. Unify on `{name}` + `style` prop; see docs/02-styles/icons.md.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Bare selection control with true / false / mixed states in two sizes. The labelled version is CheckboxField.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Bare single-choice control in two sizes. RadioField, RadioImage and RadioColor build on it.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: On/off control (Material: Switch). Has a loading state, which is unusual and worth keeping because Salla toggles often trigger a server call.
components.rtl: Thumb travels inline-start -> inline-end; on/off direction mirrors in RTL.
components.notes: Figma exports the whole toggle as one SVG per variant; rebuild it from primitives so the track and thumb take tokens. Keep the name Toggle in Storybook for continuity, alias Switch in docs.

components.name: LoadingIndicator
components.summary: Spinner, dots or line progress in nine sizes from 8px to 88px.
components.notes: Nine sizes is more than the rest of the system uses (three to six). Recommend collapsing to xs/sm/md/lg/xl and mapping the rest as aliases.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.summary: The 10px coloured dot. Base of Status.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Image, text initials, icon or fallback in six sizes, circular or rectangular.
components.notes: Placeholder image sets (_AvatarplaholderImages, _BanksPlaceholderImages) are assets, not components; move them to assets/.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Compact tag used in table cells and multi-select fields. Material: assist / filter / input chip.

components.name: Flag
components.summary: Country flag glyphs, one per ISO 3166 code (265 in Figma).
components.notes: Ship as a sprite or lazy-loaded SVGs; do not bundle 265 inline SVGs in the base package.

components.name: SocialIcon
components.summary: Brand logos (Facebook, Google, Google Ads, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X).
components.notes: Brand colours are fixed by the brands and are exempt from the token palette.

components.name: Illustration
components.summary: Spot illustrations for empty states and onboarding, with web and mobile variants.

props.name: one of the 20 collection names (add products, no codes, order filters empty ...)

components.notes: See docs/02-styles/illustrations.md for the full list and usage rules.

components.name: FieldLabel
components.summary: Label line above a field: text, optional required mark, optional info icon.

components.name: HelperText
components.summary: Line under a field: hint, error, character count, variables hint or file delete action.

components.name: PasswordHint
components.summary: One requirement line (pending / success / danger) used by PasswordField.

components.name: StepperButton
components.summary: The +/- buttons flanking QuantityField, including the delete-at-one variant.

components.name: TranslationToggle
components.summary: The small EN/AR language switch inside bilingual fields (Storybook: LingualField).

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.summary: Circular determinate progress (25/50/75/100 in Figma, should accept any value).

components.name: StepIndicator
components.summary: One node of the Stepper: number or check in a circle with a connector.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Horizontal or vertical rule. Exists implicitly as the Separator variants inside Breadcrumb and MoreMenu.

components.name: Text
components.summary: Typography primitive exposing the Material type roles (display, headline, title, body, label) that map onto the Figma Bold/Medium/Regular $text-* styles.

components.name: BaseField (internal)
components.summary: The internal base for every field: label + container (icon-start, control, subtext/unit, translation toggle, info) + helper text. Not exported. Today this role is played by InputWrapper, a 24-variant god component; splitting it into a base and named globals is the main structural change in Text inputs.
components.notes: Eight interaction states is more than a screen reader or CSS needs. Collapse to: enabled, hover, focus, filled, read-only, disabled, plus an orthogonal error flag.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: Single-line text entry. Absorbs the four internal Figma frames (plain, with button, with image, with character counter) as slots and props.
components.rtl: Text direction follows the field language, not the page; the translation toggle sits inline-end in both directions.

components.name: TextareaField
components.summary: Multi-line text entry with optional rich-text toolbar.

components.name: PasswordField
components.summary: Masked entry with show/hide toggle and an optional requirements checklist (112 Figma variants collapse to four props).

components.name: EmailField
components.summary: TextField pre-configured with type=email, mail icon and email validation.

components.name: AmountField
components.summary: Numeric / currency entry with the Saudi Riyal symbol as trailing unit.
components.rtl: Digits stay Latin (0-9) per live dashboard convention; the currency glyph sits inline-end.

components.name: PhoneField
components.summary: Phone entry with country-code picker (Flag + code) as leading control.
components.notes: Figma frame is suffixed V1; the new name drops versions from component names (version lives in the changelog).

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Search entry with magnifier, clear button, recommendations and no-results states.

components.name: OtpField
components.summary: Single-digit boxes for verification codes.
components.rtl: Code boxes always read left-to-right, even on RTL pages.

components.name: QuantityField
components.summary: Number entry with StepperButtons, compact and default sizes, and the hot-reload (inline save) variant used in tables.

components.name: SelectField
components.summary: Single-choice dropdown field. The 'basic' Figma variant (no search) is a prop, not a separate component.

components.name: MultiSelectField
components.summary: Multi-choice dropdown field rendering selections as Chips (Storybook: Tags Input).

components.name: UploadField
components.summary: File picker with drag and drop: inline, single image, single video, multiple (row or column).

components.name: ColorPickerField
components.summary: Colour swatch + hex entry with a picker popover.

components.name: CheckboxField
components.summary: Checkbox + label + optional description / info tooltip.

components.name: RadioField
components.summary: Radio + label, used inside a RadioGroup.

components.name: RadioImage
components.summary: Selectable image card (visual radio) for templates, themes, layouts.

components.name: RadioColor
components.summary: Selectable colour swatch (visual radio) for product colour variants.

components.name: SwitchField
components.summary: Switch + label with the switch at inline-start or inline-end.

components.name: Status
components.summary: StatusIndicator + label in subtle (dot + text) or strong (pill) appearance. Material: badge / chip.
components.notes: Table/Status carries nine order-status presets (waiting payment, in progress, shipped, delivered ...). Model those as a data mapping (order status -> Status type), not as extra variants.

components.name: Loading
components.summary: LoadingIndicator + localised label for block-level loading.

components.name: AvatarWithText
components.summary: Avatar + primary and secondary text lines (customer, product, staff rows).

components.name: AvatarStack
components.summary: Overlapping or spaced row of Avatars with +N overflow.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Path navigation with icon, text, more (…) and separator items; collapses past 5 items and on mobile.
states: item: default, hover, active, disabled, pressed

components.name: BreadcrumbItem
components.summary: One breadcrumb node: icon, text or overflow menu trigger.

components.name: Tab
components.summary: One tab, primary (dashboard top nav) or secondary (page sub-nav), contained or plain, with active/hover states.

components.name: NavigationItem
components.summary: One entry of the side navigation (first / middle / last for grouping radius).

components.name: MenuItem
components.summary: Row inside MoreMenu: icon or image + label, optional danger tone; separators become Divider.

components.name: ListItem
components.summary: Row inside DropdownList and pickers: plain, with description, with flag, with image; supports checkbox, selected, danger, disabled and 'feature' (upsell) states.
components.notes: The PDF names this pattern listItemLayout: a slot-based layout with fixed slots. ListSubheader (_listTitle) is the category / search header variant.

components.name: TableCell
components.summary: Typed cells: name, sub-name, image, products, amount, percentage, status, tags, markets (flag + text), variant, data (text / date-time / dropdown), actions (1-3 icons or toggle), checkbox, chip, disabled, sort and header.

props.type: one cell component per type: TextCell, NameCell, ImageCell, AmountCell, PercentageCell, StatusCell, TagsCell, MarketCell, DateCell, ActionsCell, CheckboxCell, ChipCell, HeaderCell

components.notes: Standalone per type (structure 2) so each cell has a tiny API; they share a CellLayout base for padding and alignment. Rename Varient -> VariantCell, Data -> DateCell / TextCell / SelectCell.

components.name: CalendarCell
components.summary: Day, number and time cells used by the date/time picker.

components.name: AccountMenuTrigger
components.summary: Avatar + store name + chevron in the top bar that opens the account menu.

components.name: PageTitle
components.summary: Page heading row: back / breadcrumb, title, optional status and actions slot. Desktop and mobile layouts.

components.name: LearnMore
components.summary: Help card linking to documentation, default and small sizes, desktop and mobile.

components.name: GlobalSearch
components.summary: Header search: collapsed button-only or full field.

components.name: FilterResults
components.summary: Applied-filters summary bar above a table with a clear action.

components.name: PanelHeader
components.summary: Title + actions row for Panel / Table containers, default and small.

components.name: InlineAlert
components.summary: Compact, non-dismissible alert placed under a field or inside a card (Alertbox Type=Inline).

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Contextual message with icon, optional title, body, optional button and close. Four semantic variants, default / white / transparent surfaces. Also the Table-embedded variant.
components.rtl: Accent border is border-inline-start; icon-start / close swap sides automatically.

components.name: AlertBanner
components.summary: Full-width page-level announcement (two layouts). Distinct layout and purpose from Alert, so standalone.

components.name: UpgradeCard
components.summary: Plan-upgrade promo card, desktop and mobile. Uses the feature accent.

components.name: DropdownList
components.summary: The floating list behind SelectField, MultiSelectField, pickers and menus: one to three layers, accordion, flags, images, checkboxes, descriptions, no-results and create-new states.
components.headless: useListbox / useMenu (structure 5) supplies keyboard navigation, typeahead and selection; DropdownList is the UI.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.summary: Calendar and time picker popover built from CalendarCell. Logic (ranges, locale, Hijri/Gregorian) lives in useCalendar.

components.name: MoreMenu
components.summary: Overflow (kebab) menu anchored to a trigger, three layouts, left/right placement.
components.rtl: Placement uses logical start/end; Figma's Dir=Left/Right becomes placement=end/start under RTL.

components.name: NavigationDrawer
components.summary: The dashboard side navigation (Material: navigation drawer) composed of NavigationItems and section headers.

components.name: TopAppBar
components.summary: Dark-teal top bar: logo, primary tabs, global search, notifications, account menu. Desktop and mobile.

components.name: SecondaryNavBar
components.summary: Second-level bar under the TopAppBar carrying secondary Tabs and a help / CTA area.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tab list + panels. Keyboard, roving focus and selection live in useTabs; Tab supplies the visuals.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: The merchant list view: header (title, tabs, search, filters), column headers with sort / select-all, typed cells, sticky action column, row selection with bulk bar, delete, edit sheet, pagination footer, mobile card rows, empty and filter-result states.

props.columns: array of {key, cell: TableCell type, sortable, sticky}

components.notes: Rename Figma's Status=[delevery, deliverd, in prograss, retrevied, wating payment, wating review] presets (typos) to a data mapping in docs/03-components/molecules/status.md.

components.name: MobileRow
components.summary: Card-style row for phones: order, product, customer and default layouts.

components.name: BulkEditSheet
components.summary: Side sheet opened from the DataTable bulk bar to edit selected rows.

components.name: EditSheet
components.summary: Inline edit side sheet for one row (default and minimum-cells layouts).

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Two to five step progress for wizards, desktop and mobile. Step state logic in useStepper, StepIndicator for visuals.

components.name: ActionBar
components.summary: Confirm / cancel button group, floating or flat, desktop and mobile. Material: bottom app bar / dialog actions.
components.rtl: Primary action sits inline-end in both directions.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: Mobile modal surface sliding from the bottom.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Centered modal (Storybook: Modal). Overlay, positioning, focus trap and close button; content via slots.
components.notes: Present in Storybook, missing from the Figma library. Design it in Figma from this spec.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: Card container with PanelHeader, body and footer slots (Storybook: Panel). Material: card.
tokens: sys.shape.small (8px, as NavigationDrawer and LearnMore use)
components.notes: Present in Storybook and production, missing as a top-level frame in Figma.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Hover / focus hint on a primary-container surface with a caret. Exists in Figma as a component set (used inside CheckboxField disabled-info) but has no top-level frame on the components page.
components.notes: Figma guidance on the disabled-info variants: when a control is disabled because of something the merchant can change, keep the label in normal colour and put a link in the tooltip (e.g. "Verify your email to enable notifications. Verify now").

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Transient bottom notification (Material: snackbar). Missing from both Figma and Storybook; production uses ad-hoc notifications.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Illustration + title + description + action for empty lists and no-results.

figma.related: Table Status=No Results, Drop Down List Variant=No Results

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Table footer: page size, range label, previous / next and page numbers. Desktop and mobile.
components.rtl: Previous / next chevrons mirror in RTL.

components.name: Map
components.summary: Embedded map for addresses and branches.

components.name: ListPage
components.summary: TopAppBar + SecondaryNavBar + PageTitle + DataTable in a Panel. Figma's 'Products Management' frame is this template.

components.name: ListDetailPage
components.summary: Two-pane layout used by Orders: list on one side, detail on the other, collapsing to stacked on mobile.

components.name: FormPage
components.summary: PageTitle + one or more Panels of fields + sticky ActionBar. Product add / edit, settings.

components.name: WizardPage
components.summary: Stepper + step content + ActionBar for onboarding and multi-step flows.

components.name: Orders list
components.summary: s.salla.sa/orders. ListPage template with the order-status Status mapping and MobileRow kind=order.

components.name: Products list
components.summary: s.salla.sa/products. ListPage template with ImageCell, AmountCell, QuantityField inline-save and MobileRow kind=product.

components.name: Order details
components.summary: s.salla.sa/orders/{id}. ListDetailPage template with Panels, Stepper for fulfilment progress and AvatarWithText for the customer.
